description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of different methods, labeled as Standard, Self-RAG, FactTuneClings (w/), and Clings, on a certain task. The vertical axis represents the average performance, measured in a numerical scale, while the horizontal axis lists the methods. The bars are color-coded, with Standard in orange, Self-RAG in yellow, FactTuneClings (w/) in green, and Clings in blue. The performance values range from approximately 40 to 60, with the Standard method showing the lowest performance and the Clings method showing the highest. The bars are not sorted in any specific order and there are no bars that are visually emphasized.
